title: ‘Took turns shooting’: Trans NYT exec killed by in-laws amid anti-LGBTQ+ allegations
content: Jonathan McKinsey was shot and killed by his elderly in-laws at a sports complex in California. Police arrested the suspects, Shouyong Zhang and Shili Chen, near the crime scene shortly after the incident. McKinsey's transgender identity allegedly contributed to a family conflict and legal disputes with his wife, Candice Jang. The couple was involved in divorce proceedings and allegations of domestic violence prior to McKinsey's death.

title: Anthropic flags billions in losses and AI risks ahead of IPO as Dario Amodei urges caution
content: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals a net loss of $42 billion in 2025, highlighting the high costs of AI scaling. The company reported a 12-fold revenue increase to nearly $4.6 billion, despite operating losses exceeding $8 billion. CEO Dario Amodei emphasizes the need for caution in AI deployment while addressing competitive pressures. Anthropic aims for a valuation exceeding $2 trillion in its upcoming public offering.

title: ‘UP is my karmabhoomi’: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal announces political entry
content: Divya Mittal has decided to enter independent politics as she announces her political journey in Uttar Pradesh. She aims to address various issues such as infrastructure, employment, and examination paper leaks, which require public attention. Mittal expressed her concerns about unresolved public problems stemming from a lack of governmental intent. She has called for collective public participation to facilitate meaningful political change.

title: Infosys to shift a third of 320,000 staff into specialist roles; here’s why
content: Infosys has more than 320,000 employees, but the growing impact of AI on billing models based on the number of people deployed on projects is putting pressure on the traditional headcount-driven pricing structure. The Bengaluru-headquartered IT services company is recruiting talent from leading Indian institutes as well as US campuses, with the company often competing with AI labs for the same pool of candidates.

title: Meet Sinchana Santosh, 15, who manages a Rs 13 lakh investment portfolio
content: Meet Sinchana, a remarkable 15-year-old from Bengaluru who is not just navigating Class 10 but also managing an impressive ₹13.9 lakh investment portfolio. Her financial journey kicked off when her parents invested from their insurance policies into her education. Through a series of online courses, she has become well-versed in finance.

title: M F Husain’s 1952 painting ‘The Red Girl’ sells for Rs 65 crore
content: M.F. Husain's remarkable artwork, The Red Girl, has fetched an astounding ₹65 crore at a recent Mumbai auction, eclipsing initial predictions of ₹3-5 crore. This sale underscores a rising fascination with modern Indian art, as demonstrated by other pieces achieving notable prices. Created over 70 years ago, this painting stands as a testament to the transforming art scene in India and the growing interest of collectors.

title: Europe's biggest chip company sells nothing at home, ASML exec says
content: ASML, Europe's biggest chip company, is currently selling no chipmaking machines in Europe, says executive Frank Heemskerk, blaming a lack of investment and zero new chip factories. As the US, China and India court ASML, the EU's Chips Act is falling short of its 2030 goal to double Europe's global chip market share. CEO Christophe Fouquet and CFO Roger Dassen have also warned Brussels over AI regulation and tech sovereignty.

title: Deepak Chahar says 3 bats worth Rs 1.5 lakh stolen from practice
content: Deepak Chahar took to social media to discuss the shocking theft of three high-value bats from a practice area, totaling about Rs 1.5 lakh. Displaying both surprise and worry, he mused that the thief might be unaware of their significance. Chahar proposed several solutions, including notifying the authorities or contacting the brand for new bats, even jokingly suggesting he might pray for their return.

title: How Anushka’s chole bhature search for Virat Kohli changed this Mumbai shop’s fate
content: A small chole bhature shop in Mumbai was on the brink of closure due to massive debts. After a comedian's Instagram recommendation, the business experienced sudden popularity and went viral. An order from Anushka Sharma for Virat Kohli further boosted their visibility and customer base. The brothers quickly expanded from one outlet to four as demand surged significantly.

title: Ordered phone, received soap instead, customer wins Rs 20,574 against Flipkart
content: A customer ordered a mobile phone from Flipkart but received bars of soap instead. Despite multiple complaints and a video proof, Flipkart did not resolve the issue satisfactorily. The Delhi consumer commission found Flipkart guilty of deficiency in service and unfair trade practice. Flipkart was directed to pay the customer Rs 10,574 along with compensation for mental harassment and litigation expenses.

title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s $2.9B investment: How did it reach 5,000 stores?
content: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

title: Travis Kelce’s $12.35M real estate empire: How did he build it?
content: Travis Kelce has built an impressive real estate portfolio spanning Kansas and Ohio. His reported properties include a 17,000-square-foot Leawood mansion, a 21,000-square-foot lakefront estate in Bratenahl and a former 10,000-square-foot Kansas City home. Together, the three properties cover nearly 48,000 square feet, with reported purchase prices totalling about $12.35 million. His Leawood home also reportedly served as the setting for his 2025 proposal to Taylor Swift.

title: 'If EC guided by private party, then what remains?' Calcutta HC
content: Calcutta high court scrutinized the Election Commission's handling of symbol allocation amid a political dispute. Justice Krishna Rao indicated possible collusion between the Commission and Democratic Trinamool Congress regarding the symbol. The Indian Secular Front challenged the Commission's decision regarding the symbol ‘envelope’. ISF's counsel contended that the allocation process was both unreasonable and illegal. The court has reserved its judgment on this noteworthy case.

title: Marching through the storm: ‘Hum Auratein Aazad Hain’ echoes across Delhi University
content: Women from various Delhi University colleges demonstrated for their freedom and safety against violence on Monday. They marched under the banner 'Hum Auratein Aazad Hain' despite rain, emphasizing the need for social change. Participants expressed solidarity and rejected restrictions on women's movement in response to sexual violence. The crowd included supportive men, stressing the need for changing men's attitudes toward women's safety.

Kaliningrad is a Russian territory on the Baltic Sea that is separated from mainland Russia by other countries.

title: Khalistan groups turn to jail networks to recruit operatives across north India: Intel

A recently detained operative disclosed connections to key figures while serving in Patiala jail. Agency investigations now focus on dead-drop recruitment methods and funding channels used by these groups. An SFJ-backed operatives was arrested after graffiti incidents linked to Khalistan activities. The arrested operative revealed a prior history of pro-Khalistan involvement and further recruitment efforts.

Additionally, an FIR related to extortion was registered by an assistant engineer of the PWD. AAP national convener Arvind Kejriwal has demanded Verma's dismissal and arrest. title: Bruce Willis built Parrot Cay compound with 3 homes, sold for $27M in 2019

Acquired in 2000, the land saw the addition of three custom built homes over four years, nestled within 12 bedrooms and 14 elegant bathrooms. With luxurious outdoor spaces featuring multiple swimming pools, this sale marks a record-breaking residential deal in the Caribbean, as Willis actively streamlines his property portfolio.

title: How Stephen and Ayesha Curry built an empire while giving back to Oakland

title: High-speed corridors to link UP with North East
content:
Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari​

NEW DELHI: A 630-km corridor connecting Siliguri in West Bengal with Guwahati (Assam) and Shillong (Meghalaya) will be built at a cost of Rs 61,500 crore, announced road transport and highways minister Nitin Gadkari Monday. The road transport ministry has also taken up an expressway connectivity project from Gorakhpur (UP) to Siliguri. Once completed, the two corridors will provide high-speed connectivity between Uttar Pradesh and North East. Speaking at an event, Gadkari added that the 630-km corridor, which will be the "lifeline" of North East, will have the mix of construction of greenfield (new) stretches and upgradation of existing highway connectivity to make the end-to-end travel seamless. He said the first leg of the corridor, Siliguri to Guwahati (400 km), will be built at an investment of Rs 30,000 crore and the project alignment is in approval stage.

title: 49 killed in Myanmar as junta carries airstrikes in rebel-controlled Rakhine
content: an airstrike near a market in rebel-controlled territory in western Rakhine state killed at least 49 people . the attack took place in Kyauktaw township, about 340 km (210 miles) west of Mandalay, Myanmar’s second-largest city .

title: OCs issued but possession delayed as amenities not ready: Wish Town homebuyers

title: Will Pakistan decide J&K statehood, asks CM Omar Abdullah
content: CM Omar Abdullah moved the resolution that calls on the union govt to restore full statehood . it refers to the 2000 assembly resolution accepting the state autonomy committee report and seeking greater autonomy . BJP’s Sunil Sharma called the resolution “anti-constitutional” and ‘anti-secular” .

title: Jaishankar highlights global conflicts at UN event - what's the ‘4F’ crisis
content: jaishankar spoke at the Asia Society at the conclusion of the UN High-Level Week . he highlighted the difficult state of the world, multiple conflicts and what he termed the “4F” crisis . the situation in the Middle East or West Asia remains very difficult, he said .
